"""Comprehensive LLM summarization evaluation: GPT-4 vs Claude."""
import json, math, re, warnings
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

with open("article.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    ARTICLE = f.read().strip()
with open("gpt4_answer.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    GPT4 = f.read().strip()
with open("claude_answer.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    CLAUDE = f.read().strip()

def sentences(text):
    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text.strip()) if p.strip()]

def tokens(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9$%.\-/]+", text.lower())

def ngrams(tok_list, n):
    return [" ".join(tok_list[i:i+n]) for i in range(len(tok_list)-n+1)]

def f1_from_counts(ref_c, hyp_c):
    common = sum((ref_c & hyp_c).values())
    if common == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    p = common / max(1, sum(hyp_c.values()))
    r = common / max(1, sum(ref_c.values()))
    f = 2*p*r/(p+r)
    return p, r, f

def rouge_n(ref, hyp, n):
    rc = Counter(ngrams(tokens(ref), n)); hc = Counter(ngrams(tokens(hyp), n))
    p, r, f = f1_from_counts(rc, hc)
    return {"precision": p, "recall": r, "f1": f}

def rouge_l(ref, hyp):
    a, b = tokens(ref), tokens(hyp)
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]
    for i in range(1, m+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1 if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
    lcs = dp[m][n]
    if lcs == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    p, r = lcs/n, lcs/m
    return p, r, 2*p*r/(p+r)

def bleu(ref, hyp, max_n=4):
    rt, ht = tokens(ref), tokens(hyp)
    if not ht:
        return 0.0
    precs = []
    for n in range(1, max_n+1):
        rc = Counter(ngrams(rt, n)); hc = Counter(ngrams(ht, n))
        common = sum((rc & hc).values())
        precs.append(common / max(1, sum(hc.values())))
    if any(p == 0 for p in precs):
        gmean = 0.0
    else:
        gmean = math.exp(sum(math.log(p) for p in precs)/max_n)
    bp = min(1.0, math.exp(1 - len(rt)/max(1, len(ht))))
    return gmean*bp

def syllables(w):
    w = w.lower()
    if not w:
        return 0
    w = re.sub(r"e$", "", w)
    return max(1, len(re.findall(r"[aeiouy]+", w)))

def flesch(text):
    s = sentences(text)
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())
    if not words or not s:
        return 0.0
    asl = len(words)/len(s)
    asw = sum(syllables(w) for w in words)/len(words)
    return 206.835 - 1.015*asl - 84.6*asw

def get_bert():
    global _bert
    if _bert is None:
        from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")

        model.eval()
        _bert = (tok, model)
    return _bert

    import torch
    inputs = tok(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
    with torch.no_grad():
        out = model(**inputs)
    mask = inputs["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1).float()
    vec = (out.last_hidden_state*mask).sum(dim=1)/mask.sum(dim=1)
    return vec.squeeze(0).numpy()

    tok, model = get_bert()

    he = np.stack([embed(s, tok, model) for s in sentences(hyp)])
    rn = re_/np.linalg.norm(re_, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    hn = he/np.linalg.norm(he, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    sim = hn @ rn.T
    rec = sim.max(axis=1).mean(); prec = sim.max(axis=0).mean()
    return {"precision": float(prec), "recall": float(rec), "f1": float(2*prec*rec/(prec+rec))}

]

    tl = summary.lower()
    covered = [p for p, frags in KEY_POINTS if any(f in tl for f in frags)]
    return covered

    (["23%"], "carbon pricing 23% of emissions"),
]

    p, r, f = rouge_l(ARTICLE, summary)

    cov = coverage(summary)

    return [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text.strip()) if p.strip()]

def tokens(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9$%.\-/]+", text.lower())

def ngrams(tok_list, n):
    return [" ".join(tok_list[i:i+n]) for i in range(len(tok_list)-n+1)]

def f1_from_counts(ref_c, hyp_c):
    common = sum((ref_c & hyp_c).values())
    if common == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    p = common / max(1, sum(hyp_c.values()))
    r = common / max(1, sum(ref_c.values()))
    f = 2*p*r/(p+r)
    return p, r, f

def rouge_n(ref, hyp, n):
    rc = Counter(ngrams(tokens(ref), n)); hc = Counter(ngrams(tokens(hyp), n))
    p, r, f = f1_from_counts(rc, hc)
    return {"precision": p, "recall": r, "f1": f}
